C0776.title: E-Commerce Cloud Warehouses Implanted with Trojan Software to Steal Express Delivery Label Data
C0776.summary: In 2022, Yuyao police in Zhejiang disclosed a case involving Trojan malware used to steal waybill data from express delivery origin cloud warehouses. The group entered express cloud warehouses, installed Trojan programs on waybill-printing computers to steal waybill data, and resold the data through material brokers to overseas fraud groups. The case shows how compromised warehouse printing endpoints can lead to bulk waybill data leakage and telecom fraud use.
